title: The Eagle band uptown
summary: He knew the Eagle band well and lists its players, including Frankie Dusen, Joe Johnson, Jeff Mumford, Henry Zeno and Sidney Bechet.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well did you get uptown to hear those bands like Frankie Dooson, and you mentioned Bolton only out at the-

Yeah, well, the Eagle band, I was very familiar with Eagle band. That was Frankie Dooson playing trombone, and Joe Johnson. See Jefferson? Yeah. Well Joe Johnson, man, just on all the Jeppe, the same color, same size and everything. He started trombone.
Well he was not quite as tall as Jefferson. He was about six inches shorter.
But it looked something like him.

And a very good trumpet player. He could make sense of, well Bump played with him at one time too. But when I knew them, they had Joe Johnson on trumpet, Frankie Dooson trombone, Jim Dandy playing bass, Jeff Mumford playing guitar, Henry Zeno playing drum, I wish he could have lived for you to hear him playing drums. Yeah, I've heard of him. He was great. And, uh, I see it was, uh, Daniels on bass, Jeff Mumford on guitar, Sidney Bechet on clarinet.
